The '''Rescue at Bundil II''' was a successful [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] mission to rescue POWs captured during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].

==Background==
[[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] had discovered that a number of Rebel Alliance personnel from [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] were being held prisoner on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|Dreadnaught]] ''[[VTR-LX]]''. The prison ship was currently refueling at [[Calast]] station, a civilian resort, and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nammo]] felt this was the opportune moment to disable the Dreadnaught and rescue their people.

==Rescue Mission==
[[File:B1m4y.jpg|thumb|left|125px|Y-wings assist against the Gunboats.]]

===Skirmish at Calast===
The Rebel strike force departed from the [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']] and [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspaced]] to Calast. ''VTR-LX'' was under the escort of a squadron of [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]], which moved to intercept the attacking Rebels. [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] group [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red]] provided cover as [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] group [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green]] targeted ''VTR-LX'' itself.

Local space was congested with civilian traffic, making dogfighting difficult, and the Gunboats bought enough time for the prison ship and both its accompanying [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|Escort Shuttles]] to escape into hyperspace. After finishing off the Gunboats, the Rebel force analyzed ''VTR-LX''{{'s}} hyperspace vector and concluded there was only one Imperial base it could be bound for: the nearby [[Bundil II]] platform.

===Battle at Bundil II===
{{Quote|There's only one Imperial station along that hyperspace vector."<br />"Could be tricky&hellip;|[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Devers (Rebel Alliance)|Devers]] and a pilot from [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]]|<ref name="Alliance" />}}
The Imperials were clearly not expecting the Rebel starfighters to pursue ''VTR-LX'' further and were grossly unprepared for an attack at Bundil II itself. Upon hyperspacing to Bundil II, the Rebel starfighters fell upon the two Escort Shuttles [[Griphon]] and [[Manticore (Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle)|Manticore]] and destroyed them both.

[[File:Vtlrywing.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Green Squadron makes a run on ''VTR-LX''.]]

As the platform frantically scrambled fighters and sent out distress calls, Y-wing group Green moved in on the unprotected prison ship and disabled it. This was the cue for [[Storm Unit (Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport)|Storm Unit's]] arrival; the [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|Assault Transport]] hyperspaced in, docked at the Dreadnaught's dorsal airlock, and began boarding operations.

Bundil II's starfighter garrison – a mix of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]], [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|Interceptors]], and [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|Bombers]] – attempted to defend the platform and the prison ship, but launched in a staggered pattern that made them easy to intercept. [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] and other X-wings from Red group engaged and destroyed most of the Imperial fighters, and the few Bombers that did make torpedo runs against Storm Unit scored very few hits before being picked apart by the Assault Transport's defensive turrets.
{{Quote|Our commando team left the Imperials a little present. They should be finding out about it any minute now.|[[Storm Unit (team)|Storm Unit]], moments before demolishing ''[[VTR-LX]]''|<ref name="Alliance" />}}
[[File:B1m4storm.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Storm Unit departs the dying Dreadnaught.]]

Storm Unit finished their boarding operation and made for their hyperspace point, informing their comrades that the prisoners had been rescued and they had left the Imperials "a little present" aboard the Dreadnaught – a powerful explosive. In what must have been a cathartic moment for the POWs, Storm Unit detonated the bomb, destroying ''VTR-LX'' in a massive explosion.

The Imperial frigate [[Archon (Nebulon-B2 frigate)|Archon]], responding to Bundil II's distress call, finally arrived, but was too late and too far out of range to prevent the Rebels' safe escape into hyperspace.

Among the prisoners to be liberated was [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Kupalo]], a high-ranking tactical officer and a favorite within the Rebel [[Alliance High Command/Legends|High Command]].

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Our guests wanted us to pass along a message: Thanks for bringing us home! First round is on us.|[[Storm Unit (team)|Storm Unit]]|<ref name="Alliance" />}}
Although the rescue mission was a success, this operation would have serious consequences for the Alliance in the coming months. One of the Echo Base personnel rescued, [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Kupalo]], had previously served aboard the ''Defiance'' for two years and was welcomed back into active service. However, during his captivity, Kupalo had secretly been brainwashed by the Empire into becoming a double agent. When Imperial Commander [[Zaletta]] defected to the Alliance some months later with top secret data on the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]], Kupalo would betray the Alliance and attempt to eliminate Zaletta along with the Alliance forces escorting him. Fortunately, he was stopped by fellow pilots [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] and [[Olin Garn]] from the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']], who served under Kupalo's command. After his capture, Kupalo would be put into extensive rehabilitation, leaving Zaletta to assume command of the ''Liberty''{{'s}} pilots.
